messages:
PagerBot: [ALERT] 2026-03-18T02:13Z eu-north1 network fabric errors causing GPU pod evictions in pool=reserved-eun1. Eviction rate 38%, queue wait >200s. https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-2026-041

Alex: ack. Seeing a bunch of CNI errors and TCP stalls in host logs. Pulling k8s events now.

Shubham: kernel logs show `mlx5_core` link flaps then pod-level ENETDOWN. Might be NIC firmware regression after last network agent update.

Alex: actions per runbook: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) scale up spare pool in eu-west2 3) shift non-critical load off region.

Alex: `kubectl get events -n gpu-system --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -n 40`

Tess: spare reserved GPUs in eu-north1 = 4/40 free. We can drain at most 6 nodes before hitting capacity floor.

Maria: propose traffic steering: move batch/non-PL routes to eu-west2, keep low-latency customer routes in eu-north1. Staged weights: 15% -> 40% -> 70% over 12m.

Jun: fine with that, but note cross-region KV cold misses will affect long-running chat sessions. We should add a warming job: `tools/cache-warm --prefixes routes-heavy --region eu-west2`

Shubham: NIC firmware rollback plan: roll back net-agent to v1.9.2 on a small canary set of nodes, observe for 10m. If stable, roll to rest.

CloudOpsBot: auto-ticket created: CLOUD-7593: eu-north1 NIC firmware regression. Link: https://internal.redwood/ops/CLOUD-7593

Alex: executing cordon/drain on affected subset: `infra nodes cordon --label region=eu-north1 --selector 'fabric=unstable'`

PagerBot: autoscaler note: will not scale to > 90% of quota without manual approval. Current quota headroom: 2 GPUs in eu-north1, 12 in eu-west2.

Tess: can we get temporary quota reallocation from eu-north1 to eu-west2? Cloud provider limits hunting will be messy. CloudOps, can you help?

CloudOpsBot: pinged @cloud-ops, requested emergency reallocation. ETA ~25m. Ticket CLOUD-7594 created.

Maria: proposal for paging flow tweak (iteration): add a mid-tier async notification to #infra-gate at 6m (summary, no mobile) and only escalate to mobile on-call at 12m. Also: if eviction rate >30% persist for 4m, trigger immediate cloud-ops escalation. Rationale: avoid waking leads for transient fabric flaps while ensuring cloud quota/fabric issues get quick attention.

Jun: add to handoff checklist: "confirmed spare quota and cloud ticket link" and "cache-warm task started". Also require a short latency sample from smoke: `curl -s https://smoke.internal/latency?region=eu-west2 | jq .p50`

Shubham: initial mitigation: rollback net-agent on 2 canary nodes, results: no evictions in canaries after 7m. Proceeding with controlled roll (max 3 nodes at a time).

Alex: shifting 15% background traffic to eu-west2 now: `infra traffic shift --from eu-north1 --to eu-west2 --routes background --weight 0.15 --staged 6m`

PagerBot: update: eviction rate down to 22% after canary rollback and 15% shift. Queue wait now ~130s.

Tess: cloud-ops update: reallocation request received, provider says they can reassign 8 GPUs to eu-west2 within ~18m, pending approval.

Maria: PR to pagerflow config with proposed timing: 6m async to #infra-gate, 12m mobile page to on-call, immediate cloud-ops on persistent eviction threshold. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/pagerbot/pulls/88

Alex: marking incident as partial-mitigated while we finish firmware roll and reallocation. Will handoff at 04:00 UTC to Jun with checklist.

Jun: will take 04:00 handoff. Handoff checklist I will post when starting.

PagerBot: [RESOLVED] 2026-03-18T03:45Z state -> mitigated (manual ack by Alex)
